collection.description: At the camp, the day you turn eighteen, everyone gives you advice and a small gift.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: At the camp, the day you turn eighteen, everyone gives you one piece of advice and one small gift. (name1) ends up with a pile of shells, a fishing hook, a very old mask-string, and a great deal of advice, most of it contradictory. (He/she) decides to keep the gifts, and keep the advice for later, and see which of it turns out to be any good.
